title: Objective auto-policy authority (P15.10-A): owner opt-in control plane, finite limits, transitions+receipts, kill-scope OBJECTIVE; no driver
description: Adds objective_auto_policy authority (owner-scoped, CAS-versioned, event-anchored): default OFF incl. legacy, finite limits required (expires_at+>=1 cap), transitions DISABLED/ENABLED/PAUSED/REVOKED/EXPIRED/HALTED with idempotent convergent retries, terms_digest_binding = objective_digest invalidation on amend/owner change, immutable per-version transition anchors (pins_digest) re-proved on every read/control/replay, durable applied_ops idempotency ledger, lazy EXPIRED, OBJECTIVE-scope halt+reset only (no business/global authority seam). evaluate() re-proves binding live and always reports driver_ready:false + missing AUTO_DRIVER_NOT_INTEGRATED/COST_BINDING_UNVERIFIED. API: owner-only GET/POST /api/vnext/objectives/:id/auto-policy with header-only actor (canonical operator:<id> derivation, strict boundary typing — no coercion). UI: Objectives page auto-policy block, no optimistic state. Cost lineage: no cost binding written in A; enforcement deferred to B/C. No model/executor/mission/Telegram calls anywhere in the change.
